# Semantic association of semantic illusions

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(stringr)
library(reshape2)

setwd("experiment1")
```

## Read data
```{r}
sem_df <- read.csv(file.path("results", "kuperberg_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    mutate("cond" = as.factor(cond))
```

## Kuperberg

### Initial exploration
By condition
```{r}
sem_df |>
    group_by(cond) |>
    summarize(
        "mean" = mean(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE),
        "sd" = sd(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE),
        "max" = max(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE),
        "min" = min(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE),
        "NAs" = sum(is.na(semantic_association))
    )
```

```{r}
sem_df |>
    mutate("cond" = as.factor(cond)) |>
    group_by(implementation, model, cond) |>
    summarize(
        "mean" = mean(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE),
        "sd" = sd(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = model, color = cond, group = cond)) +
    geom_point(
        aes(y = mean),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.3),
        size = 2
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
        width = 0.15,
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
        values = c("blue", "firebrick2", "purple", "orange")
    ) +
    labs(x = "") +
    facet_wrap(. ~ implementation, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

ggsave(file.path("figs", "semantic_association_kuperberg.png"), width = 7, height = 10)
```

```{r}
sem_df |>
    mutate("cond" = as.factor(cond)) |>
    group_by(model, implementation, cond) |>
    summarize(
        "mean" = mean(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE),
        "sd" = sd(semantic_association, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = cond, color = cond, group = cond)) +
    geom_point(
        aes(y = mean),

    ) +

        aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),

    ) +

```

```{r}
sem_df |>
    mutate("cond" = as.factor(cond)) |>
    group_by(implementation, model) |>
    mutate(semantic_association = scale(semantic_association)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = semantic_association, fill = cond)) +
    # geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("blue", "firebrick2", "purple", "orange")
    ) +
    labs(x = "") +
    facet_wrap(. ~ implementation, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal() +

    )
```

Difference from baseline
```{r}
sem_df |>
    mutate("cond" = as.factor(cond)) |>
    group_by(implementation, model, scenario) |>
    mutate(
        diff_from_baseline = `semantic_association` - `semantic_association`[cond == 1]
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(cond != 1) |>
    group_by(implementation, model, cond) |>
    summarize(
        "mean" = mean(diff_from_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
        "sd" = sd(diff_from_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
        "max" = max(diff_from_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
        "min" = min(diff_from_baseline, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
```


```{r}
sem_df |>
    mutate("cond" = as.factor(cond)) |>
    group_by(implementation, model, scenario) |>
    mutate(
        diff_from_baseline = `semantic_association` - `semantic_association`[cond == 1]
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(cond != 1) |>
    group_by(implementation, model) |>
    mutate(diff_from_baseline = scale(diff_from_baseline)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = diff_from_baseline, fill = cond)) +
    # geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("firebrick2", "purple", "orange")
    ) +
    labs(x = "") +
    facet_wrap(. ~ implementation, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
```

### Correlations in estimates between models
```{r}
cor_matrix <- sem_df |>
    mutate(name = paste("sem", implementation, model, sep = "_")) |>
    select(name, semantic_association, cond, scenario) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = semantic_association) |>
    select(starts_with("sem_")) |>
    cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Remove prefix
prefix <- "^sem_"
colnames(cor_matrix) <- str_remove(colnames(cor_matrix), prefix)
rownames(cor_matrix) <- str_remove(rownames(cor_matrix), prefix)
```

```{r}
prefix_order <- c("BERTWE", "WE", "CWE", "SE")

level_order <- colnames(cor_matrix)[
    order(match(str_extract(colnames(cor_matrix), "^[^_]+"), prefix_order))
]

melted <- melt(cor_matrix) |>
    mutate(
        Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = level_order),
        Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = level_order)
    )

ggplot(melted, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
        midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Correlation") +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```

```{r}
data_one_implementation <- sem_df |>
    filter(
        implementation == "SE"
    )

model_diff_fit <- lmer(
    sem_s ~ model + (1 | scenario),
    data = data_one_implementation |>
        group_by(model) |>
        mutate(sem_s = scale(semantic_association))
)
summary(model_diff_fit)
```

### Modeling Difference in conditions
```{r}
data_one_model <- sem_df |>
    filter(
        model == "enwiki_20180420_100d" &
            implementation == "WE"
    )
```

```{r}
naive_fit <- lm(semantic_association ~ cond, data = data_one_model)
summary(naive_fit)
```

```{r}
group_level_fit <- lmer(
    semantic_association ~ cond + (1 | scenario),
    data = data_one_model
)
summary(group_level_fit)
```


### Semantic association in specific scenarios
```{r}
sem_df |>
    filter(scenario == 56) |>
    select(target, model, implementation, semantic_association)
```

```{r}
scenario_number <- 27

sem_df |>
    group_by(implementation, model) |>
    mutate(
        sem_s = scale(semantic_association),
        implementation_model = paste(implementation, model, sep = " : "),
        context_target = paste(context, target, sep = "..."),
    ) |>
    mutate(cond_sentence = paste(cond, context_target, sep = ": ")) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(scenario == scenario_number) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = implementation_model, y = cond_sentence, fill = sem_s)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue3", high = "red2", mid = "thistle1",
        na.value = "grey",
        midpoint = 0, , limit = c(-5, 5)
    ) +
    labs(y = "", x = "", fill = "semantic association") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = .5)

sem_df |>
    filter(scenario == scenario_number) |>
    select(sentences, cond)
pull(sentences) |>
    unique()
```
